name: @pipeworx/mcp-odoo

tools.name: odoo_search_partners
tools.description: Search Odoo contacts & companies (res.partner) by name, email, or company flag. Returns id, name, email, phone, and company/customer flags. Use for "find the contact/customer named X" or "list companies".

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

name.description: Case-insensitive substring match on partner name (ilike).

is_company.description: Filter to companies (true) or individuals (false). Omit for both.

tools.name: odoo_list_sale_orders
tools.description: List Odoo sales orders / quotations (sale.order). Returns name, customer (partner_id), amount_total, state (draft/sent/sale/done/cancel), and date_order. Optionally filter by state. Use for "recent sales orders" or "open quotations".

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

state.description: Filter by order state: draft, sent, sale, done, or cancel. Omit for all.

tools.name: odoo_list_crm_leads
tools.description: List Odoo CRM leads & opportunities (crm.lead). Returns name, contact, email_from, expected_revenue, probability, stage_id, and type (lead/opportunity). Use for "open opportunities" or "sales pipeline".

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

type.description: Filter by record type: "lead" or "opportunity". Omit for both.

tools.name: odoo_list_invoices
tools.description: List Odoo customer invoices (account.move where move_type=out_invoice). Returns name, partner_id, amount_total, amount_residual, state (draft/posted/cancel), payment_state, and invoice_date. Use for "unpaid invoices" or "recent customer invoices".

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

state.description: Filter by invoice state: draft, posted, or cancel. Omit for all.

tools.name: odoo_query_model
tools.description: Power-user generic query: run search_read on ANY Odoo model. Provide model (e.g. "product.template"), domain (Odoo list-of-triples, e.g. [["list_price",">",100]]), fields, and limit. Use when no specific tool above fits.

url.description: Odoo instance base URL, e.g. https://mycompany.odoo.com (trailing slash optional). Works for Odoo Online and self-hosted.

_apiKey.description: Odoo API key (Settings → Account Security → API Keys) or account password.

domain.description: Odoo search domain — a list of triples [field, operator, value], e.g. [["active","=",true],["name","ilike","acme"]]. Empty array [] matches all.

fields.description: Field names to return, e.g. ["name","create_date"]. Omit to let Odoo return its default field set.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-odoo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the odoo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
